lines: Phase 2, engine and blockout. No unit or round yet. Since Status 10: the new stage drew its first picture, and the app is published again with the three kept sounds on the review page (the globe there is still the measuring scene).
Next: the stage, the particles, the interface and the film with the app come together on main, then the blockout round.
phase 2: 1.86 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 3.05 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The first picture of the new stage, which replaces the measuring scene: winter at rest from the hero camera at draft. Stand-in shapes for the cottage, the tree, the base and the lights, with the lens and the mirror pass on. A blockout, not a look. (by engine_builder)
The interface on a phone, over the approved spring image on a mock: the season marks above the Shake control, sound beside it. (by interface_builder)
The 3 kept sounds as waveforms, each with its name, length and loudness
